description: After months of public opposition, the Escambia County Sheriff’s Office and Pensacola Police Department suspended their automated license plate reader systems and turned off the cameras. Francesca Yabraian, a candidate for Florida House District 1, said the next step is clear.
title: WE THE PEOPLE: CITIZEN BACKLASH EXPOSES SALZMAN’S SURVEILLANCE HYPOCRISY AS FLOCK CAMERAS ARE SUSPENDED IN ESCAMBIA COUNTY
